candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarify course and associated severity features.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Persistent blood in stool needs contextual assessment.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Questions about duration, recurrence and relevant associated symptoms are acceptable even where exact details are absent.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek exposure/travel history AND medicine/antibiotic treatment history or response.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Exposure and treatment can inform the infection-versus-inflammation assessment without naming the eventual diagnosis.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Broad relevant travel/exposure and medication enquiries count; exact destination/drug names are not required if unavailable.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek relevant existing infection/inflammatory investigation evidence.
candidate_requirements.rationale: A final cause should not be established from the short history alone.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Stool infection studies and/or relevant inflammatory blood/endoscopic assessment are acceptable routes; do not require every test or a supplied result.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek personal extraintestinal history, including musculoskeletal symptoms AND previous skin lesions.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Such history may discriminate between explanations of persistent bloody diarrhoea.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A broad personal associated/past-symptom question reasonably covering these features can count; exact shin-lesion wording is not required. Bowel-only recurrence or family history alone does not establish this request.
